mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lingxing_product_weight (sku, gross_weight, net_weight, sync_time) VALUES (#{sku}, #{grossWeight}, #{netWeight}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE gross_weight = COALESCE(VALUES(gross_weight), gross_weight), net_weight = COALESCE(VALUES(net_weight), net_weight), sync_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW()
